faq_subtitle: Everything you need to know about XCANNES
faq_q1: Why a subscription instead of fees per trade?
faq_a1: Because it's more transparent and fairer. With a fixed subscription, you know exactly what you pay each month. No fees accumulating with each trade, no hidden spread eating your profits. Trade as much as you want, you always pay the same. Simple.
faq_q2: How does XCS reduce my subscription?
faq_a2: 1 XCS in your wallet = $1 discount per month. Automatic. If you have 15 XCS, you pay $14.90 instead of $29.90. If you have 29.90, it's free for life. The system detects your balance and applies the discount instantly. Your tokens stay in your wallet, they're never consumed.
faq_q3: Is the displayed price really without spread?
faq_a3: Yes. Really. We add NO spread on top of the real XRPL market price. The price you see in the orderbook is the exact price you trade at. No hidden margin, no manipulation. You only pay XRPL network fees (about 0.00001 XRP per transaction).
faq_a4: Absolutely. Your XCS are standard XRPL tokens. You can buy, sell, transfer them whenever you want. As long as they're in your wallet, they reduce your subscription. If you sell them, you return to the standard rate. You decide.
faq_q5: What happens if I don't have XCS?
faq_a5: You simply pay the standard $29.90/month subscription. You have access to all features, real price without spread, full interface. XCS is just a way to save, not a requirement to trade.
